as_told.title: Jake Barber's first-person testimony to Senate intelligence committee
as_told.place_text: Senate Select Committee on Intelligence, Washington, D.C.

plain: Jake Barber, a man who says he flew a helicopter to recover a UFO, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that he went to Congress, to the Senate committee that oversees intelligence agencies and to the official who monitors the CIA, the US spy agency, to tell everything he knew, and that they asked him for help. A journalist, Ross Coulthart, also says Barber's first-hand evidence was given to that Senate committee. If true, his account would have reached the people in government charged with checking secret programs.
